messages:
Ava Li: Quick thread for the tri-mode landing refresh (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Scope: hero line + one-line benchmark or trust cue, two CTAs (product & enterprise), and inbound routing rules. Freeze by EOD Fri.
Sam - copy: Ill draft micro-headlines that differentiate by intent: build (Hosted), predictable capacity (Dedicated), and control (Private). Will keep Hosted developer-forward.
Riley (growth): Routing ground rules: Hosted -> self-serve (signup funnel), Dedicated -> AE queue (demo), Private -> AE + security. Immediate AE if keywords: "compliance", "on-prem", "enterprise", or company_size > 500.
Devon (design): Want badge option for Hosted hero (performance micro-badge) and an alternate control without badge. Well A/B test badge impact on signups. Need copy for tooltip.
Kai (infra): Provisional stat for Dedicated: "~160k tokens/sec cluster (typical)". Can confirm model-dependent numbers tomorrow. Safe to use as a micro-callout with caveat.
Sam - copy: Draft micro-copy (short):
- Hosted hero A: "Hosted API. Start building in minutes."
  subline: "Low-latency inference, no infra ops."
  CTAs: "Create free account" / "See benchmarks"
- Hosted hero B (performance badge): badge text "Sub-200ms 99th (common workloads)"; tooltip: "Measured on representative workloads; results vary by model and request pattern."
- Dedicated hero: "Reserve GPU capacity for predictable throughput."
  subline: "SLA-backed uptime and configurable autoscale."
  CTAs: "Request capacity review" / "Get pricing"
- Private hero: "Private deployments: VPC, on-prem, and customer-managed keys."
  subline: "Audit-ready controls and enterprise SLAs."
  CTAs: "Talk to sales" / "Request security brief"
Ava Li: Love the structure. Keep Hosted hero numbers out of main headline if possible. Use badge variant for a microtest.
Riley (growth): UTM plan: append ?utm_source=landing&utm_campaign=tri_mode_test&utm_content=variantX to CTA links. Map utm_content -> SFDC queue. Will provide YAML mapping after copy is final.
Devon (design): For the badge control we need two CTA styles: secondary subtle and primary bold. Send exact CTA copy by noon so we can mock variants.
Kai (infra): Confirming Dedicated micro-stat tomorrow AM. Also suggest a short infra note on Dedicated page: "examples: model X at seq-512" — but keep it link-out to docs.
Sam - copy: Webinar tie-in (Hosted): short blurb: "Live demo: batching & caching to cut inference cost. 30-min demo + Q&A." CTA: "Register" with calendar link. We'll link benchmark page from "See benchmarks" CTA.
Riley (growth): Routing pseudo-code sketch (will convert to YAML):
```
if message_or_form contains /HIPAA|SOC2|PCI|compliance|on-prem|enterprise/i -> route: AE + security
else if company_employees > 500 or estimated_mrr > 10000 -> route: AE
else if intent_tag contains ("embed","prototype","api-test") -> route: self-serve
else -> route: AE-review (hold 24h then auto-assign)
```
launch-bot: Reminder: copy freeze deadline 1790086400 (Fri 23:59 UTC).
Ava Li: Next steps: Sam posts final hero + subline + two CTAs per mode in this thread by EOD today. Riley posts routing YAML & UTM mapping. Kai confirms Dedicated stat. Devon will prepare A/B mocks once copy arrives. Thanks team. :rocket:
